create.name: Minnesota Sakya Center (Sakya Thupten Dargye Ling)
create.bio:
Sakya Thupten Dargye Ling, better known as the Minnesota Sakya Center, is a Tibetan Buddhist community in the Twin Cities area belonging to the Sakya school. It belongs, as a local branch, to Tsechen Kunchab Ling, the American seat of the Sakya Dolma Phodrang, and His Holiness the 41st Sakya Trichen is its spiritual director. The centre has no permanent temple of its own: it meets for study and practice in the Minneapolis area, and larger events are held in hired venues sized to the expected audience. Over the decades it has hosted many senior Sakya lamas, among them the Sakya Trichen himself, whose Minnesota visits drew large gatherings of both Tibetan and Western students.

Its resident teacher, Khenpo Thupten Gongphel, gives a continuing Sunday series on Shantideva's Way of the Bodhisattva using a traditional Tibetan commentary, and a weekly online study group works through the same text with recorded teachings by the 42nd Sakya Trizin. There are also classes in Tibetan for young people, community and children's days with a shared lunch, and seasonal holy-day pujas. Its website collects free practice texts and articles, and its YouTube channel holds recorded teachings by the Sakya Trichen on refuge, the preliminary practices and meeting difficult times.
